Account Executive/Sales (m/f/d)München, HybridFull-timePermanent employeeRoleHive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our RF communication systems are Made in Germany, deployed on active frontlines, and targeting a highly valued tactical communication market with zero sovereign alternatives today.As our first dedicated Account Executive, you own the sales pipeline: every opportunity from a lead to a signed contract. You take over our existing customer accounts and drive the opportunities our founders and Business Development have opened, with the first new deals expected to close within 3 months. You currently report to the CEO.This role is customer-facing by design: expect 30–50% travel to customer sites, procurement offices, partners and trade fairs across Germany and Europe, sometimes internationally. The rest of the time you work alongside Engineering, Product Management and our Field Application Engineers.Responsibilities- Own the funnel from the first qualified conversation to signature. Our founders and Business Development open doors with customers, partners and the wider ecosystem. From there the opportunity is yours: you qualify it, drive it and close it, pulling the founders back in only when a deal needs them. Leads you generate yourself count just as much, this isn't exclusively BD's territory.- Qualify hard and early. Run discovery against a fixed gate (pain, budget, decision-making unit, timing) before we invest engineering time in a technical deep dive, and keep a clear next step with a date on every opportunity.- Lead the customer's buying team through a hardware buying cycle: end users, engineers, procurement, legal and IT, across long evaluations, equipment trials run as projects, integration questions and security reviews.- Orchestrate the deal team. Bring in our engineers and Field Application Engineers for demos, trials and technical deep dives, and Product Management for configuration and fit. You decide when a deal needs them and what they're there to do.- Own our active customers commercially: account plans, follow-on orders, upsells and expansion into new units and use cases, every escalation that touches the relationship, and regular account reviews with the Field Application Engineer who owns adoption.- Turn deployed systems into the next deal: reference visits, customer quotes and case material that you or the founders can use to open new accounts.- Own the offer: configuration and pricing, terms and conditions, the cost-benefit case on the customer's own data, and the project plan to signature. Lead our responses to RFPs and tenders where they apply, and build the templates so every proposal starts from a proven base.- Get a trial agreement signed before any trial starts: scope, duration, success criteria, pilot price and the path to the main contract. You drive it, Operations owns the paperwork.- Close, and hand over cleanly. Request the contract from Operations, keep the customer and the internal side moving, and sign. Then hand over to Operations as a confirmed customer order and to the Field Application Engineer for onboarding.- Keep the pipeline honest: stage discipline, forecast and CRM hygiene, and a weekly pipeline review you run for the foundersRequirementsMust Have- 7+ years in B2B sales of technical products into complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally in a scale up company- You have sold hardware, or hardware combined with software and firmware: physical systems with configurations, lead times, integration work and delivery commitments behind them- Comfortable selling to technical and non-technical stakeholders in the same room, and knowing when to bring in the engineers- Hands-on daily work in a CRM and a disciplined qualification method (e.g. MEDDPICC): your forecast is something the company can plan on- Closer's mindset: you treat an opportunity without a next step and a date as a problem, not a pipeline entry- Structured working style: your offers, decisions and customer commitments are written down so that Operations, the field team and the founders can act on them without asking- Willingness to travel 30–50 % across Germany and Europe, occasionally beyond Europe- Fluent English (German is a very big plus)- Eligibility and willingness to undergo security vetting for access to some customer sitesNice to Have- An existing network or experience selling to the DACH defense ecosystem: armed forces, procurement offices, primes, integrators- Technical fluency in RF communication, embedded systems, unmanned systems, command-and-control or robotics- Experience building a sales pipeline or sales function from scratch rather than inheriting oneÜber unsWe work in deep-tech and dual-use technology, an industry where women and other underrepresented groups have historically had limited access. We encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box below.Why Hive- Build sovereign technology that matters. We build RF communication and orchestration systems for unmanned platforms across air, land, sea, and space, at a moment when European technological sovereignty is a real strategic question, not an abstract one.- Real ownership, real deployment. Our products are already in serial production and in the field. What you build ships, and you see the result.- Small team, direct access. Around 30 people. You'll work directly with founders and not through multiple layers of management.- You shape the foundations. We're still building the structures, career paths, controlling, compliance, that let a fast-growing company scale well. You'll help decide what they look like.- Modern Munich office, with the tools and equipment to do your best work.What You Get- **Compensation. **We benchmark salaries to stay competitive for the market and the role, not just what an early-stage budget can spare.- Equity. You participate in Hive through equity/VSOP, a genuine stake in what we build, not just a paycheck.- A role you shape, not one you're handed. We're too early for fixed job descriptions or a career ladder. What you own grows as you take on more, not by climbing steps someone else defined.- No bureaucracy. Small, flat team. Decisions happen in a conversation, not a sign-off chain.Compensation and equity terms vary by role and level.Hive Robotics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or marital status. Please don't include data on ethnic origin, political views, religious beliefs, union membership, health, or sexual orientation in your application.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: CRM-Systeme

Job descriptionIn order to support our security operations, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a Business Security Manager (d/f/m)As a Business Security Manager, you will serve as a strategic liaison between business units, cross-functional teams, and security teams. In this role, you will apply an engineering mindset to integrate security requirements throughout the entire Programme Life Cycle—from contract negotiation to development, production, and in-service support. You will ensure security risks and regulatory obligations, particularly those involving governmental classified information and defense contracts, are proactively addressed, embedded into operational workflows, or escalated to specialist teams when necessary.This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.Your locationOur site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.Our Benefits for You- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.Your tasks and responsibilities- Act as the primary point of contact for security inquiries across business units, translating complex security requirements into actionable operational practices.- Ensure security compliance, risk mitigation, and classified data protocols are seamlessly embedded across every phase of the Program Life Cycle.- Apply structured, analytical problem-solving to evaluate technical processes, identify vulnerabilities, and harmonise security practices in close collaboration with business units to improve efficiency and compliance.- Provide security expertise during initial contract negotiations and ongoing contract management, ensuring customer and supplier agreements align with national security frameworks and regulations.- Elevate awareness of security obligations and risks within business activities.- Partner with security teams to align business goals with country-specific regulatory environments and organizational standards.- Identify synergies across programas and functions to streamline security workflows, share best practices, and support the delivery of security training and awareness programs.Required Skills & Experience & Mindset- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Security Management, or a related technical or scientific discipline (additional professional certifications in security, risk management, or systems engineering are a plus).- Minimum of 5 years of experience in security management, technical programme management, or engineering business partnership roles.- Deep, practical understanding of the Programme Life Cycle within complex manufacturing or engineering environments, combined with strong analytical problem-solving skills to address root causes.- Proven experience handling governmental classified information, defense or military aerospace programmes, and national security protocols (preferably in an international context).- Eligibility for a German security clearance (Geheimschutz) and familiarity with Airbus products, operational processes, and organizational structure.- Exceptional communication, stakeholder engagement, and strategic risk management skills, with the ability to thrive under pressure in cross-functional environments.- Negotiation-level fluency in both German and English; knowledge of French or Spanish is an asset.Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.Take your career to a new level and apply online now!#MYCYMThis job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growthBy submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.description: About Allianz Global InvestorsAllianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. Our shared goal to shape a future of opportunity for our clients is foundational to our culture and our values. We look to attract, and actively nurture, individuals with the drive to achieve excellence at every stage of the investment experience.We believe an inclusive culture is key to a flourishing workforce. Not only do we celebrate the broad range of experiences, backgrounds, and attributes that our workforce brings, but we support our people to live and work in a way that promotes their own wellbeing.Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.  We are united by a shared commitment: to put our clients first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.  Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future - for our clients and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture.  We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. If you feel inspired to promote the active asset management experience, this is the place for you. Join our international, technology-enabled, and agile environment. Simply upload your CV in English to apply for this position.  If you need support to navigate our websites or at any stage during your application, please send an email with your request to recruiting@allianzgi.com. To Recruitment Agencies:Allianz Global Investors has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz Global Investors does not accept unsolicited resumes from agency or search firm recruiters.When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place.Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz Global Investors.Finally, please do not contact hiring managers directly.Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.How to Apply: Applying is quick and easy. Simply upload your CV, complete your personal details, confirm your consent for AI support in the "Additional Information" section, and submit your application.To support our recruiters, we use Fit Score—an AI‑powered tool that highlights how closely your profile aligns with the role. This helps us review applications more efficiently and focus on what matters most: your skills and experience.Good to know: The Fit Score is a support tool only. At Allianz, technology never replaces human judgment. Every application is carefully reviewed by our recruiting teams, ensuring a fair, thoughtful, and personal hiring process.108430 | Data & AI | Professional | n.a. | Allianz Global Investors | Full-Time | PermanentAllianz Global Investors is building a trusted, well-governed data foundation and making it ready for Artificial Intelligence (AI). As AI moves into everyday investment and business processes, our ambition is for AI applications and agents to work from enterprise data and context that is understandable, traceable and used only where permitted - so their output is accurate, explainable and safe to rely on.This role leads the development of the capability that makes this possible: the framework, standards and ways of working that connect our data and business context to AI, end to end - and its adoption across the firm.This position will be based in Munich or Frankfurt.What you will do- Own and evolve the capability - the framework that brings together business meaning, data, governance and AI-usage context so enterprise data becomes usable, and trustworthy, for AI- Build the creation and ownership model - enable business functions to create and maintain the context AI relies on, and set the guidelines they follow- Govern how context is used - ensure the right access, classification and governance are applied, set the standards data and context must meet before AI can use them, and define how AI is guided to the most relevant context- Design how AI consumes trusted context - curate the context, instructions and feedback loops behind AI use cases, and decide with platform engineering what is exposed to AI and how it is governed and ranked- Drive adoption across the firm - roll the model out to business areas, encourage and enable users, and build the training that makes it stick- Sustain it over time - keep a living library of context current as usage grows, and measure whether context is genuinely improving AI outcomes and implement a lean operating model- Keep it compliant and connected - ensure that our governance meets EU regulatory expectations (DORA, the EU AI Act, GDPR), and partner closely with legal, data, platform engineering and business teamsWhat you bringEssential- A track record of building and scaling a capability or operating model across a large, complex organisation - ideally in data governance, data management, knowledge management or AI enablement - coaching and influencing teams that retain ownership, rather than relying on formal authority- Data governance and regulatory knowledge (DORA, EU AI Act, GDPR) and how these apply to the use of data by AI- A good understanding of data modelling and semantics / ontologies, and why they matter for making data AI-ready- Conceptual fluency in generative AI and retrieval, sufficient to design and govern how AI consumes context (building the pipelines is done by platform engineering)- Familiarity with a modern data platform such as Databricks / Unity Catalog - governance, lineage, classification and metadata- Excellent stakeholder management, communication and enablement - able to make technical concepts accessible and to build adoption across business and technical teamsDesirable- Experience in asset management or financial services- Experience standing up and scaling a governance, knowledge or enablement capability- Hands-on experience with ontology tooling and metadata / catalogue platforms and/or data contextWhat we offer- We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours)- Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans- Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities)- Company share purchasing plan- Mental health and wellbeing programs- Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket)- Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group- Self-guided learning & development- Volunteering time- … and so much more!
